name: External PSD Edit Plugin
description: ArtMesh context-menu entry that exports the complete raw PSD, opens it in the system default PSD application, and applies Cubism native explicit-target replacement on save.

permissions.reason: Read texture relations to resolve selected ArtMeshes to their current raw image and validate session bindings.
Apply Cubism native explicit-target raw-image replacement when a watched temporary PSD is saved.
Read the runtime-issued temporary PSD revision for replacement.
Export the complete raw PSD to a runtime-owned temporary file.
Open the temporary PSD in the operating system's default PSD application.
Report session, import, and pause/failure status to the user.
Confirm once before opening multiple temporary PSDs.
Register the external PSD edit action invoked from ArtMesh context menus.
Expose external PSD editing in ArtMesh-capable Editor context menus.
Read the captured ArtMesh context-menu selection that triggers editing.
